web-content-editor.faq_intro: Categories are shown as tabs on the website, questions in their order. The answer is plain text - its lines are kept.
web-content-editor.faq_remove_category: Remove the category with its questions
web-content-editor.jobs_intro: The preview (title and short description) is shown in the list of positions, the type, place and text blocks in the detail. The text is plain - lines and bullets (•) are kept.
web-content-editor.jobs_slug_hint: Lower-case letters without accents, digits and hyphens. Changing it changes the link of the position.
web-content-editor.jobs_slug_invalid: The address may contain lower-case letters without accents, digits and hyphens only.
web-content-editor.jobs_slug_duplicate: Every position needs its own address.
web-content-editor.refs_intro: The projects are shown on the website in this order. The row of the list shows the name, year and client, the detail the other data. The text is plain - lines are kept.
web-content-editor.refs_neutral_hint: Year and client are the same in every language.
web-content-editor.refs_image_hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB. Saved at once (independent of Save). Shown on the website to the right of the key features.
web-content-editor.refs_image_save_first: The image can be uploaded once the reference is saved.
web-content-editor.refs_image_error_type: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
web-content-editor.refs_image_error_size: The image may have at most 5 MB.
web-content-editor.missing_field: Translation missing - the website shows "Cannot load text".
web-content-editor.missing_warning: Missing translations ({lang}): {count}. The website shows "Cannot load text" instead.
web-content-editor.saved_message: The changes are on the website.
web-content-editor.load_error: The content could not be loaded. Reload the page.
web-content-editor.text_hint: Everything is saved at once with Save. An optional field empty in every language is not shown on the website.
